[EN] Goddess' Truth
[ES] Verdad de la diosa
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sure, I can do that."
[ES] "Claro, puedo hacerlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do what I can."
[ES] "Haré lo que pueda."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take a pegasus to see Georrif in Acarum.
[ES] Toma un pegaso para ver a Georrif en Acarum.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet Kennance at the Glacial Bay Research Station in Tempest Reach.
[ES] Reúnete con Kennance en la Estación de Investigación de Glacial Bay en Tempest Reach.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can do that."
[ES] "Puedo hacer eso."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Versa.
[ES] Busca a Versa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt the ossugon icelord and retrieve the mana wave map.
[ES] Caza al señor del hielo ossugon y recupera el mapa de ondas de MP.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll take care of it."
[ES] "Yo me encargo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the mana wave map back to Versa.
[ES] Llévale el mapa de ondas de MP de vuelta a Versa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Remove the mana wave map.
[ES] Retira el mapa de ondas de MP.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the first gauge.
[ES] Encuentra el primer indicador.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Off we go."
[ES] "Allá vamos."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the second gauge.
[ES] Encuentra el segundo indicador.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll see you later."
[ES] "Te veo luego."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow the path and find the person who wrote the note.
[ES] Sigue el camino y encuentra a la persona que escribió la nota.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do it right away."
[ES] "Lo haré de inmediato."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Matil.
[ES] Habla con Matil.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Spectral Blood
[ES] Sangre espectral
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt drowned bosuns and drowned officers near Beacon Point Garrison.
[ES] Caza contramaestres ahogados y oficiales ahogados cerca de Beacon Point Garrison.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the spectral blood to Matil.
[ES] Llévale la sangre espectral a Matil.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the Dark Caller, Seraeno, and capture the Onyx Breath.

[Caution] If the quest item is destroyed, you must abandon and restart the quest.
[ES] Mata a la invocadora oscura, Seraeno, y captura el Aliento de ónix.

[Precaución] Si el objeto de misión es destruido, debes abandonar y reiniciar la misión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bloody Tombstone
[ES] Lápida sangrienta
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Quiescent Purifier on the Onyx Breath. Use the result to destroy the tombstones in the maelstrom.

[Caution] If the quest item is destroyed, you must abandon and restart the quest.
[ES] Usa el Purificador de quietud en el Aliento de ónix. Usa el resultado para destruir las lápidas en el torbellino.

[Precaución] Si el objeto de misión es destruido, debes abandonar y reiniciar la misión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Find peace."
[ES] "Encuentra la paz."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the tombstone in the center of the Maelstrom.
[ES] Encuentra la lápida en el centro del torbellino.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "What do you mean?"
[ES] "¿Qué quieres decir?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Ona.
[ES] Habla con Ona.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm honored. Thank you."
[ES] "Es un honor. Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Zenobia.
[ES] Habla con Zenobia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right away."
[ES] "Enseguida."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to Matil.
[ES] Informa a Matil.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Harule in Acarum.
[ES] Informa a Harule en Acarum.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
